note: Amano's second suit (suit_amano_2) on the family's nude body (m01, RoeNudeBody). Her black vines are painted into the suit's skin texture (pc_m02_hd_skin uses body1's albedo), so the suit's skin is itself the last piece (each material is its own outfit entry: the skin, the tentacles and the wings share seam points and would weld into one piece): it fades out where it is (fade: nothing flies) and the nude body under it is drawn once it is off (reveal). Stage 1: the dark tentacle arc over her head and behind her (body2). Stage 2: the glowing blue wings with their black frames (body3). Stage 3: the vines - the painted skin fades and the bare body is left. The first rule that matches a piece decides; pieces no rule matches stay on.
